headline: Egypt Signs USD 1 Billion World Bank Financing Agreement
summary: Egypt signed a USD 1 billion World Bank financing agreement on November 1 to support reforms on state firms, private investment, borrowing costs, and green energy.
why: International financial institution backing provides crucial balance-of-payments support and signals institutional confidence in structural economic reforms.

impacts.name: Egypt
impacts.why: Multilateral financing aids government fiscal reforms and external liquidity.
